name: Balanced 4-1-4-1

slots.why: Starts short passing moves; a compact block does not need a sweeper.
Support full-back helps the wide midfielder without overlapping unless it is safe.
Central defender in a settled back four. Cover is the alternate.
Ball-playing defender starts moves with passes to the holding midfielder and the wide players.
Support full-back on the right, doing the same job as on the left.
Holding midfielder protects the centre-backs and takes the ball off them; he stays in front of the defence.
Wide midfielder provides width and tracks back to help the full-back.
Defensive central midfielder pairs with the holding midfielder to keep the block tight.
Box-to-box midfielder is the runner who joins the striker's attacks.
Wide midfielder on the right, doing the same job as on the left.
Lone striker attacks the space. Poacher stays in the box; Advanced Forward runs the channels.

description: A compact 4-1-4-1 with a dedicated screen behind a four-man midfield.
whyGood: It gives strong defensive spacing and central control while retaining wide outlets.
whyThisShape: A compact 4-1-4-1: a holding midfielder screens the defence behind a flat line of four midfielders, with one striker. It is hard to play through the middle and balances defence with support for the striker.
whenToUse: As a safe default when you want control without committing many players forward, or away from home against a stronger side.
whenNotToUse: When you need to chase a goal: there is a single striker and no creative attacking midfielder to feed him.

instructionRationale.Standard Line of Engagement: A balanced press keeps the two banks of four compact rather than chasing the ball.
instructionRationale.Standard Defensive Line: A balanced line suits a side that wants to stay compact without taking risks.
instructionRationale.Shorter Passing: Keeps possession in the compact midfield line.
instructionRationale.Regroup: Falls back into the two banks after losing the ball.
